notes: coSow Live 0.5.7. Fixes the other side not being transcribed on 0.5.6: the app now keeps one macOS identity across builds. One time: System Settings > Privacy & Security > Screen & System Audio Recording, remove every coSow Live or cosow-live entry with the minus button, open coSow Live, allow it, Quit & Reopen (the microphone asks once too). If the other side is ever not heard while listening, the card now says so within 8 seconds, with Open System Settings and Retry. On Apple silicon use the arm64 DMG; first launch is System Settings > Privacy & Security > Open Anyway.
